profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: Experienced software engineering leader looking to find a way to enrich the world with my work and hoping to foster/support the talents of the engineers I work with. Mostly focused on cloud back-end work.

positions.title: Director of Product Engineering
positions.description:
Heavily Used Tech: AWS (Lambda, CloudWatch, CloudFormation, S3, CloudFront, DynamoDB, RDS, APIGateway, Cognito), Python
Less Used Tech: AWS (StepFunctions, IAM, Route53, CodePipeline, CodeDeploy, SQS, SNS, KMS , ECS Fargate), Typescript, GraphQL

My responsibilities:
Building the process ====
-CI/CD
-Code reviews
-Communication training
-Logging / Alerting / Error handling philosophy

Building the team ====
-Building Culture
-Built frameworks for evaluation/promotion
-Recruitment philosophy/training/interviews
-Worked with HR/senior leadership on behalf of engineering to normalize esop / insurance / various other policies

Building the product ====
-Designed scalable architecture
-Backend Python code / CloudFormation arch
-Worked with design team
-Worked with customer success team
-High profile customer escalations
-Worked on Auth system, rules processing engine, data pipeline, various other backend pieces

positions.title: CTO
positions.description:
This was a startup that I helped to bootstrap. The goal was the on demand delivery of beauty services in Korea. We successfully completed an Android App, iPhone App, and cloud backend. We also partnered with a famous stylist, but funding difficulties caused the dissolution of the company in 2017.

Tech: Python, Swift, Java, AWS(S3, Lambda, DynamoDB, RDS, Cognito, API Gateway)

My responsibilities:
- Recruiting
- Cloud Infrastructure (AWS primarily serverless)
- DevOps
- iOS App
- Android App
- Investor meetings

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Tech: Python, C, Bash, Javascript, AWS(EC2, IAM), Vmware, Hyper-V

My responsibilities:
-Performance testing
-New platform development
-Developing contract manufacturing process for platforms
-Distribution for virtual solutions (AWS, Vmware, Hyper-V)
-Escalations/Testing/Builds/Lab management
-Recruiting/Training
-Supporting other teams (Marketing/IT/Solutions Arch/Sales/Support/Manufacturing)

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Tech: C#, C++, Javascript, Java, Python

My responsibilities:
- Contributed to continuous content publishing system and search integration for Windows websites and Windows 7/8 services
- Participated in Security Review Team
- Helped to design/build UI Components for the Windows Client and Windows websites
- Mentored other new hires/interns; participated in on campus recruitment efforts
- Contributed to development tools for Windows Live
